const letters := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
const lowercase_letters := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
const columns := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNO"

int character_index(string alphabet, string character)
    for: i < int(#alphabet)
        if alphabet[i] == character
            return i
    return -1

string uppercase(string text)
    result := ""
    for: i < int(#text)
        at := character_index(lowercase_letters, text[i])
        result += if at >= 0 then letters[at] else text[i]
    return result

string lower_letter(string character)
    return lowercase_letters[character_index(letters, character)]

bool inside(int row, int column)
    return 0 <= row and row < 15 and 0 <= column and column < 15

class Move(int row, int column, int direction, string word)
class Tile(int row, int column, string letter)

string square_name(int row, int column)
    return columns[column] + string(row + 1)

string position(Move move)
    return if move.direction == 0 then string(move.row + 1) + columns[move.column] else square_name(move.row, move.column)

int[] parse_position(string text)
    for: row < 15
        for: column < 15
            for: direction < 2
                if position(Move(row, column, direction, "")) == text
                    return [row, column, direction]
    return []

string[][] premiums()
    rows := ["#..+...#...+..#", ".*...^...^...*.", "..*...+.+...*..", "+..*...+...*..+", "....*.....*....", ".^...^...^...^.", "..+...+.+...+..", "#..+...*...+..#", "..+...+.+...+..", ".^...^...^...^.", "....*.....*....", "+..*...+...*..+", "..*...+.+...*..", ".*...^...^...*.", "#..+...#...+..#"]
    return [for row := rows[] then [for c := (0:<15)[] then row[c]]]

string[][] empty_board()
    return [for row := (0:<15)[] then [for column := (0:<15)[] then "."]]

string[][] transpose(string[][] grid)
    return [for row := (0:<15)[] then [for column := (0:<15)[] then grid[column][row]]]

Tile[] transpose_tiles(Tile[] placed)
    return [for tile := placed[] then Tile(tile.column, tile.row, tile.letter)]

Tile[] tiles(string[][] grid)
    Tile[] found := []
    for: row < 15
        for: column < 15
            letter := grid[row][column]
            if letter != "."
                found = found.append(Tile(row, column, letter))
    return found

int[][] neighbours(int row, int column)
    int[][] candidates := [[row - 1, column], [row + 1, column], [row, column - 1], [row, column + 1]]
    return [for point := candidates[] if inside(point[0], point[1]) then point]

Move run_at(string[][] grid, int row, int column, int direction)
    dr := direction
    dc := 1 - direction
    while inside(row - dr, column - dc) and grid[row - dr][column - dc] != "."
        row -= dr
        column -= dc
    first_row := row
    first_column := column
    word := ""
    while inside(row, column) and grid[row][column] != "."
        word += grid[row][column]
        row += dr
        column += dc
    return Move(first_row, first_column, direction, word)

Move[] words(string[][] grid)
    Move[] result := []
    for: direction < 2
        for: line < 15
            offset := 0
            while offset < 15
                row := if direction == 0 then line else offset
                column := if direction == 0 then offset else line
                if grid[row][column] == "."
                    offset += 1
                    continue
                word := run_at(grid, row, column, direction)
                if #word.word >= 2
                    result = result.append(word)
                offset += int(#word.word)
    return result

bool connected(string[][] grid)
    occupied := tiles(grid)
    if #occupied == 0
        return true
    visited := [for row := (0:<15)[] then [for column := (0:<15)[] then false]]
    int[][] queue := [[occupied[0].row, occupied[0].column]]
    visited[occupied[0].row][occupied[0].column] = true
    cursor := 0
    while cursor < int(#queue)
        point := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for next := neighbours(point[0], point[1])[]
            if grid[next[0]][next[1]] != "." and not visited[next[0]][next[1]]
                visited[next[0]][next[1]] = true
                queue = queue.append(next)
    return #queue == #occupied

string[] display(string[][] grid)
    layout := premiums()
    lines := ["   " + [for i := (0:<15)[] then columns[i]].join(" ")]
    for: row < 15
        padding := if row < 9 then " " else ""
        lines = lines.append(padding + string(row + 1) + " " + [for column := (0:<15)[] then (if grid[row][column] == "." then layout[row][column] else grid[row][column])].join(" "))
    return lines

class Trie()
    int[][] children := [[for i := (0:<26)[] then -1]]
    terminal := [false]
    word_count := 0

    bool .add(string word)
        node := 0
        for: i < int(#word)
            letter := board.character_index(board.letters, word[i])
            if children[node][letter] < 0
                created := int(#children)
                children[node][letter] = created
                children = children.append([for j := (0:<26)[] then -1])
                terminal = terminal.append(false)
            node = children[node][letter]
        if terminal[node]
            return false
        terminal[node] = true
        word_count += 1
        return true

    int prefix(string word)
        node := 0
        for: i < int(#word)
            letter := board.character_index(board.letters, word[i])
            if letter < 0 or children[node][letter] < 0
                return -1
            node = children[node][letter]
        return node

    bool has(string word)
        int node := prefix(word)
        return node >= 0 and terminal[node]

    string[] anagram_visit(int node, string word, int[] counts)
        string[] result := if terminal[node] then [word] else []
        for: letter < 26
            child := children[node][letter]
            if child < 0
                continue
            tile := if counts[letter] > 0 then letter else 26
            if counts[tile] > 0
                remaining := counts
                remaining[tile] -= 1
                result = result.concat(anagram_visit(child, word + board.letters[letter], remaining))
        return result

    string[] anagrams(string rack)
        counts := [for i := (0:<27)[] then 0]
        for: i < int(#rack)
            tile := if rack[i] == "?" then 26 else board.character_index(board.letters, rack[i])
            counts[tile] += 1
        return anagram_visit(0, "", counts)

const tile_order := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ?"

int tile_index(string tile)
    return if tile == "?" then 26 else board.character_index(board.letters, tile)

int points(string collection, int[] values)
    result := 0
    for: i < int(#collection)
        result += values[tile_index(collection[i])]
    return result

class Bag(int state, int[] counts)
    string[] tiles := []
    for: i < 27
        for: j < counts[i]
            tiles = tiles.append(tile_order[i])

    int .next_random()
        state = (48271 * state) % 2147483647
        return state

    void .shuffle()
        i := int(#tiles) - 1
        while i >= 1
            int j := .next_random() % (i + 1)
            temporary := tiles[i]
            tiles[i] = tiles[j]
            tiles[j] = temporary
            i -= 1

    string .draw(int amount)
        drawn := ""
        for: i < amount
            if #tiles == 0
                break
            last := int(#tiles) - 1
            drawn += tiles[last]
            tiles = tiles[0:<last]
        return drawn

    string .exchange(string returned)
        string drawn := .draw(int(#returned))
        sorted := [for i := (0:<int(#returned))[] then returned[i]].sorted()
        tiles = tiles.concat(sorted)
        .shuffle()
        return drawn

import board = "./board.qui"
import dictionary_trie = "./dictionary_trie.qui"
import move_generator = "./move_generator.qui"
import scoring = "./scoring.qui"
import game = "./game.qui"

int integer(string text)
    result := int(text)
    return result

bool valid_name(string text)
    if #text < 1 or #text > 20
        return false
    for: i < int(#text)
        if board.character_index("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_", text[i]) < 0
            return false
    return true

bool valid_number(string text, int minimum, int maximum)
    if #text == 0 or (#text > 1 and text[0] == "0")
        return false
    for: i < int(#text)
        if board.character_index("0123456789", text[i]) < 0
            return false
    value := integer(text)
    return minimum <= value and value <= maximum

bool valid_rack(string rack)
    if #rack < 1 or #rack > 7
        return false
    for: i < int(#rack)
        if board.character_index(game.tile_order, rack[i]) < 0
            return false
    return true

bool valid_strategy(string strategy)
    return strategy == "score" or strategy == "tiles" or strategy == "equity"

bool valid_word(string word, bool uppercase_only)
    if #word < 2 or #word > 15
        return false
    string alphabet := if uppercase_only then board.letters else board.letters + board.lowercase_letters
    for: i < int(#word)
        if board.character_index(alphabet, word[i]) < 0
            return false
    return true

bool lex_less(string first, string second)
    return first != second and [first, second].sorted()[0] == first

string sorted_tiles(string text)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#text))[] then text[i]].sorted().join("")

string collection(string text)
    return if #text == 0 then "-" else sorted_tiles(text)

int[] tile_counts(string text)
    result := [for i := (0:<27)[] then 0]
    for: i < int(#text)
        result[game.tile_index(text[i])] += 1
    return result

string kind_of(string character)
    return if board.character_index(board.letters, character) >= 0 then character else "?"

string remove_tiles(string rack, string removed)
    counts := tile_counts(rack)
    for: i < int(#removed)
        counts[game.tile_index(removed[i])] -= 1
    result := ""
    for: i < 27
        result += game.tile_order[i] * nat(counts[i])
    return sorted_tiles(result)

int string_index(string[] values, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

string placement_key(board.Tile[] placed)
    result := ""
    for: row < 15
        for: column < 15
            for tile := placed[]
                if tile.row == row and tile.column == column
                    result += "{row},{column}:" + tile.letter + ";"
    return result

class Evaluated(board.Move move, int score, board.Tile[] placed, string words, string leave, int value)

string notation(Evaluated evaluated)
    return board.position(evaluated.move) + " " + evaluated.move.word

bool before(Evaluated first, Evaluated second, string strategy)
    primary_first := if strategy == "tiles" then int(#first.placed) else (if strategy == "equity" then first.score + first.value else 0)
    primary_second := if strategy == "tiles" then int(#second.placed) else (if strategy == "equity" then second.score + second.value else 0)
    if primary_first != primary_second
        return primary_first > primary_second
    if first.score != second.score
        return first.score > second.score
    if first.move.row != second.move.row
        return first.move.row < second.move.row
    if first.move.column != second.move.column
        return first.move.column < second.move.column
    if first.move.direction != second.move.direction
        return first.move.direction < second.move.direction
    return lex_less(first.move.word, second.move.word)

Evaluated[] sorted_moves(Evaluated[] moves, string strategy)
    if #moves < 2
        return moves
    middle := int(#moves) / 2
    left := sorted_moves(moves[0:<middle], strategy)
    right := sorted_moves(moves[middle:<int(#moves)], strategy)
    Evaluated[] result := []
    a := 0
    b := 0
    while a < int(#left) and b < int(#right)
        if before(right[b], left[a], strategy)
            result = result.append(right[b])
            b += 1
        else
            result = result.append(left[a])
            a += 1
    return result.concat(left[a:<int(#left)]).concat(right[b:<int(#right)])

int strategy_choice(Evaluated[] moves, string strategy)
    result := 0
    for: 1 <= i < int(#moves)
        if before(moves[i], moves[result], strategy)
            result = i
    return result

class Inputs()
    int[] values := []
    int[] counts := []
    int[] weights := []
    local tiles_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/tiles.txt"))
    for line := tiles_text.split(NL)[]
        if line == "" or line[0] == "#"
            continue
        string[] fields := line.split(" ")
        values = values.append(integer(fields[1]))
        counts = counts.append(integer(fields[2]))
        weights = weights.append(integer(fields[3]))
    trie := dictionary_trie.Trie()
    candidate_lines := 0
    skipped := 0
    duplicates := 0
    int[] lengths := [for i := (0:<16)[] then 0]
    local dictionary_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/dictionary.txt"))
    for line := dictionary_text.split(NL)[]
        if line == "" or line[0] == "#"
            continue
        candidate_lines += 1
        if not valid_word(line, true)
            skipped += 1
        else
            bool added := .trie.add(line)
            if added
                lengths[int(#line)] += 1
            else
                duplicates += 1
    string[][] jobs := []
    string[] current := []
    local jobs_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/jobs.txt"))
    for line := jobs_text.split(NL)[]
        if #current == 0
            if line != "" and line[0] != "#"
                current = [line]
        elif line == "END"
            jobs = jobs.append(current)
            current = []
        else
            current = current.append(line)
    string[] length_parts := [for k := (2:<16)[] if lengths[k] > 0 then "{k}={lengths[k]}"]
    string[] dictionary_lines := ["DICTIONARY lines={candidate_lines} words={trie.word_count} skipped={skipped} duplicates={duplicates} nodes={#trie.children}", "lengths " + length_parts.join(" ")]

class Checked(string reason, board.Move move, bool placing)

class Scrabble(Inputs input_data)
    int[] values := input_data.values
    int[] counts := input_data.counts
    int[] weights := input_data.weights
    dictionary_trie.Trie trie := input_data.trie
    top_totals := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    validation_totals := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    game_totals := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    string[][] move_blocks := [input_data.dictionary_lines]
    string[][] validation_blocks := []
    string[][] game_blocks := []

    int[] used_tiles(string[][] grid, string rack)
        used := tile_counts(rack)
        for tile := board.tiles(grid)[]
            used[game.tile_index(kind_of(tile.letter))] += 1
        return used

    string tile_error(string[][] grid, string rack)
        int[] used := used_tiles(grid, rack)
        for: i < 27
            if used[i] > counts[i]
                return "too many " + game.tile_order[i]
        return ""

    string unseen(string[][] grid, string rack)
        int[] used := used_tiles(grid, rack)
        return [for i := (0:<27)[] then game.tile_order[i] * nat(counts[i] - used[i])].join("")

    string[][] grid_from(string[] rows)
        return [for row := rows[] then [for c := (0:<int(#row))[] then row[c]]]

    string board_error(string[] rows, string rack)
        if #rows != 15
            return "board rows {#rows}"
        for: i < 15
            if #rows[i] != 15
                return "bad board row {i + 1}"
            for: j < 15
                if board.character_index("." + board.letters + board.lowercase_letters, rows[i][j]) < 0
                    return "bad board row {i + 1}"
        string[][] grid := grid_from(rows)
        string reason := tile_error(grid, rack)
        if reason != ""
            return reason
        if #board.tiles(grid) != 0 and grid[7][7] == "."
            return "center empty"
        if not board.connected(grid)
            return "disconnected"
        for word := board.words(grid)[]
            if not trie.has(board.uppercase(word.word))
                return "unknown word " + word.word + " at " + board.position(word)
        return ""

    string job_error(string[] job, string[] seen)
        fields := job[0].split(" ")
        kind := fields[0]
        name := fields[1]
        if not valid_name(name)
            return "bad name"
        if string_index(seen, name) >= 0
            return "duplicate name"
        if kind == "TOPN"
            if not valid_number(fields[2], 1, 99)
                return "bad count"
            if not valid_strategy(fields[3])
                return "bad order"
            rack := job[1].split(" ")[1]
            if not valid_rack(rack)
                return "bad rack"
            return board_error(job[3:<int(#job)], rack)
        if kind == "VALIDATE"
            string[] rows := []
            for line := job[2:<int(#job)][]
                if line.starts_with("MOVE")
                    break
                rows = rows.append(line)
            return board_error(rows, "")
        if not valid_number(fields[2], 1, 2147483646)
            return "bad seed"
        player_count := int(#job) - 1
        if player_count < 2 or player_count > 4
            return "bad player count {player_count}"
        string[] names := []
        for: 1 <= i < int(#job)
            player := job[i].split(" ")
            if not valid_name(player[1]) or not valid_strategy(player[2])
                return "bad player {i}"
            if kind == "GAME" and not valid_number(player[3], 0, 99)
                return "bad player {i}"
            if string_index(names, player[1]) >= 0
                return "duplicate player {i}"
            names = names.append(player[1])
        return ""

    int leave_value(string rack)
        quantities := tile_counts(rack)
        duplicates := 0
        vowels := 0
        consonants := 0
        result := 0
        for: i < 27
            result += quantities[i] * weights[i]
            if i < 26
                if quantities[i] > 1
                    duplicates += quantities[i] - 1
                if board.character_index("AEIOU", game.tile_order[i]) >= 0
                    vowels += quantities[i]
                else
                    consonants += quantities[i]
        imbalance := vowels - consonants
        if imbalance < 0
            imbalance = -imbalance
        penalty := if imbalance > 1 then imbalance - 1 else 0
        return result - 4 * duplicates - 3 * penalty

    string best_leave(string rack)
        best := ""
        best_value := 0
        distinct<string> seen
        for: mask < 2 ^ int(#rack)
            candidate := ""
            for: i < int(#rack)
                if (mask / (2 ^ i)) % 2 == 1
                    candidate += rack[i]
            if #candidate == #rack
                continue
            candidate = sorted_tiles(candidate)
            if seen.has(candidate)
                continue
            .seen.add(candidate)
            int value := leave_value(candidate)
            if value > best_value or (value == best_value and (#candidate > #best or (#candidate == #best and lex_less(candidate, best))))
                best = candidate
                best_value = value
        return best

    Evaluated evaluate(string[][] grid, string rack, board.Move move)
        scored := scoring.score_move(grid, move, values)
        removed := [for tile := scored.placed[] then kind_of(tile.letter)].join("")
        leave := remove_tiles(rack, removed)
        words := [for i := (0:<int(#scored.words))[] then scored.words[i].word + ":" + string(scored.word_scores[i])].join(",")
        return Evaluated(move, scored.score, scored.placed, words, leave, leave_value(leave))

    Evaluated[] legal_moves(string[][] grid, string rack)
        Evaluated[] result := [for move := move_generator.generate(grid, rack, trie)[] then evaluate(grid, rack, move)]
        return sorted_moves(result, "score")

    string position_summary(string[][] grid)
        board.Move[] words := board.words(grid)
        board.Tile[] occupied := board.tiles(grid)
        longest := "-"
        longest_length := 0
        for word := words[]
            if int(#word.word) > longest_length
                longest_length = int(#word.word)
                longest = word.word
        blanks := 0
        premium_counts := [0, 0, 0, 0]
        symbols := "#*^+"
        layout := board.premiums()
        for tile := occupied[]
            if kind_of(tile.letter) == "?"
                blanks += 1
            at := board.character_index(symbols, layout[tile.row][tile.column])
            if at >= 0
                premium_counts[at] += 1
        return "position tiles={#occupied} words={#words} longest={longest} blanks={blanks} premiums=TW:{premium_counts[0]},DW:{premium_counts[1]},TL:{premium_counts[2]},DL:{premium_counts[3]}"

    string check_statistics(move_generator.Checks checks)
        squares := 0
        dead := 0
        letters := 0
        for: row < 15
            for: column < 15
                if checks.needed[row][column]
                    squares += 1
                    count := int(#[for allowed := checks.allowed[row][column][] if allowed then allowed])
                    letters += count
                    if count == 0
                        dead += 1
        return "{squares},{dead},{letters}"

    string[] ordered_anagrams(string rack)
        found := trie.anagrams(rack).sorted()
        string[] result := []
        length := 15
        while length >= 2
            for word := found[]
                if int(#word) == length
                    result = result.append(word)
            length -= 1
        return result

    string[] .topn(string[] job)
        fields := job[0].split(" ")
        name := fields[1]
        requested := integer(fields[2])
        strategy := fields[3]
        rack := job[1].split(" ")[1]
        string[][] grid := grid_from(job[3:<int(#job)])
        Evaluated[] moves := legal_moves(grid, rack)
        ordered := sorted_moves(moves, strategy)
        shown_count := if requested < int(#ordered) then requested else int(#ordered)
        shown := ordered[0:<shown_count]
        string remaining := unseen(grid, rack)
        anchor_squares := move_generator.anchors(grid)
        anchor_count := 0
        for row := anchor_squares[]
            anchor_count += int(#[for item := row[] if item then item])
        vowels := 0
        consonants := 0
        blanks := 0
        for: i < int(#rack)
            if rack[i] == "?"
                blanks += 1
            elif board.character_index("AEIOU", rack[i]) >= 0
                vowels += 1
            else
                consonants += 1
        across := int(#[for move := moves[] if move.move.direction == 0 then move])
        bingos := int(#[for move := moves[] if #move.placed == 7 then move])
        blank_moves := 0
        for move := moves[]
            if #[for tile := move.placed[] if kind_of(tile.letter) == "?" then tile] != 0
                blank_moves += 1
        string[] lines := ["TOPN {name} n={requested} order={strategy} rack=" + collection(rack), "board tiles={#board.tiles(grid)} anchors={anchor_count}", "unseen count={#remaining} tiles=" + collection(remaining), "rack vowels={vowels} consonants={consonants} blanks={blanks} value={game.points(rack, values)}", "checks across=" + check_statistics(move_generator.cross_checks(grid, trie)) + " down=" + check_statistics(move_generator.cross_checks(board.transpose(grid), trie)), "moves total={#moves} across={across} down={int(#moves) - across} bingos={bingos} blanks={blank_moves}"]
        best_by_tiles := "best_by_tiles"
        for: 1 <= count <= 7
            best := -1
            for move := moves[]
                if int(#move.placed) == count and move.score > best
                    best = move.score
            best_by_tiles += " {count}=" + (if best < 0 then "-" else string(best))
        lines = lines.append(best_by_tiles)
        string keep := best_leave(rack)
        lines = lines.append("exchange keep=" + collection(keep) + " value={leave_value(keep)}")
        string[] anagrams := ordered_anagrams(rack)
        anagram_count := if #anagrams < 10 then int(#anagrams) else 10
        lines = lines.append("anagrams total={#anagrams} top=" + (if anagram_count == 0 then "-" else anagrams[0:<anagram_count].join(",")))
        for word := board.words(grid)[]
            if #word.word < 3
                continue
            front := ""
            back := ""
            for: i < 26
                string letter := board.letters[i]
                if trie.has(letter + board.uppercase(word.word))
                    front += letter
                if trie.has(board.uppercase(word.word) + letter)
                    back += letter
            if front != "" or back != ""
                lines = lines.append("hook " + board.position(word) + " " + word.word + " front=" + (if front == "" then "-" else front) + " back=" + (if back == "" then "-" else back))
        endgame := 1 <= #remaining and #remaining <= 7 and shown_count > 0
        int[] nets := []
        if endgame
            for move := shown[]
                Evaluated[] replies := legal_moves(scoring.apply(grid, move.placed), remaining)
                nets = nets.append(move.score - (if #replies == 0 then 0 else replies[0].score))
            best := 0
            for: 1 <= i < shown_count
                if nets[i] > nets[best]
                    best = i
            lines = lines.append("endgame opponent=" + collection(remaining) + " best={best + 1} net={nets[best]}")
        for: i < shown_count
            move := shown[i]
            net := if endgame then " net={nets[i]}" else ""
            lines = lines.append("{i + 1} " + notation(move) + " score={move.score} tiles={#move.placed} leave=" + collection(move.leave) + " value={move.value}" + net + " words={move.words}")
        top_totals[2] += int(#moves)
        top_totals[3] += bingos
        return lines

    Checked record_error(string[][] grid, string player, string rack, string[] action)
        absent := board.Move(0, 0, 0, "")
        if not valid_name(player)
            return Checked("bad player", absent, false)
        if not valid_rack(rack)
            return Checked("bad rack", absent, false)
        string reason := tile_error(grid, rack)
        if reason != ""
            return Checked(reason, absent, false)
        if #action == 1 and action[0] == "PASS"
            return Checked("", absent, false)
        if action[0] == "EXCHANGE"
            if not valid_rack(action[1])
                return Checked("bad exchange", absent, false)
            available := tile_counts(rack)
            requested := tile_counts(action[1])
            for: i < int(#action[1])
                tile := game.tile_index(action[1][i])
                if requested[tile] > available[tile]
                    return Checked("rack lacks " + action[1][i], absent, false)
            return Checked("", absent, false)
        parsed := board.parse_position(action[0])
        if #parsed == 0
            return Checked("bad position", absent, false)
        if not valid_word(action[1], false)
            return Checked("bad word", absent, false)
        move := board.Move(parsed[0], parsed[1], parsed[2], action[1])
        cells := scoring.squares(move)
        for tile := cells[]
            if not board.inside(tile.row, tile.column)
                return Checked("off board", absent, false)
        for tile := cells[]
            if grid[tile.row][tile.column] != "." and grid[tile.row][tile.column] != tile.letter
                return Checked("mismatch at " + board.square_name(tile.row, tile.column), absent, false)
        dr := move.direction
        dc := 1 - move.direction
        int[][] ends := [[move.row - dr, move.column - dc], [move.row + dr * int(#move.word), move.column + dc * int(#move.word)]]
        for point := ends[]
            if board.inside(point[0], point[1]) and grid[point[0]][point[1]] != "."
                return Checked("not whole word", absent, false)
        placed := scoring.placement(grid, move)
        if #placed == 0
            return Checked("no new tiles", absent, false)
        available := tile_counts(rack)
        for tile := placed[]
            kind := kind_of(tile.letter)
            index := game.tile_index(kind)
            if available[index] == 0
                return Checked("rack lacks " + kind, absent, false)
            available[index] -= 1
        if #board.tiles(grid) == 0
            if #[for tile := placed[] if tile.row == 7 and tile.column == 7 then tile] == 0
                return Checked("center not covered", absent, false)
        else
            connected := false
            for tile := placed[]
                for point := board.neighbours(tile.row, tile.column)[]
                    connected = connected or grid[point[0]][point[1]] != "."
            if not connected
                return Checked("not connected", absent, false)
        for word := [move].concat(scoring.cross_words(grid, move))[]
            if not trie.has(board.uppercase(word.word))
                return Checked("unknown word " + word.word + " at " + board.position(word), absent, false)
        return Checked("", move, true)

    string[] .validate(string[] job)
        name := job[0].split(" ")[1]
        string[][] grid := grid_from(job[2:<17])
        records := job[17:<int(#job)]
        lines := ["VALIDATE {name}"]
        string[] players := []
        int[][] statistics := []
        totals := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
        for: i < int(#records)
            fields := records[i].split(" ")
            player := fields[1]
            rack := fields[2]
            action := fields[3:<int(#fields)]
            prefix := "move {i + 1} {player} " + action.join(" ")
            Checked checked := record_error(grid, player, rack, action)
            p := string_index(players, player)
            if checked.reason != "bad player"
                if p < 0
                    p = int(#players)
                    players = players.append(player)
                    statistics = statistics.append([0, 0, 0, 0])
                statistics[p][0] += 1
            if checked.reason != ""
                lines = lines.append(prefix + " invalid " + checked.reason)
                totals[1] += 1
                continue
            Evaluated[] legal := legal_moves(grid, rack)
            best := if #legal == 0 then 0 else legal[0].score
            score := 0
            evaluated := Evaluated(board.Move(0, 0, 0, ""), 0, [], "", "", 0)
            rank := 0
            if checked.placing
                evaluated = evaluate(grid, rack, checked.move)
                score = evaluated.score
                key := placement_key(evaluated.placed)
                for: j < int(#legal)
                    if placement_key(legal[j].placed) == key
                        rank = j + 1
                        break
            statistics[p][1] += 1
            statistics[p][2] += score
            statistics[p][3] += best - score
            totals[0] += 1
            totals[2] += score
            totals[3] += best
            totals[4] += best - score
            if checked.placing
                lines = lines.append(prefix + " score={score} total={statistics[p][2]} tiles={#evaluated.placed} rank={rank}/{#legal} best={best} words={evaluated.words}")
                grid = scoring.apply(grid, evaluated.placed)
            else
                lines = lines.append(prefix + " score=0 total={statistics[p][2]} moves={#legal} best={best}")
        for: p < int(#players)
            stats := statistics[p]
            lines = lines.append("player {players[p]} moves={stats[0]} valid={stats[1]} score={stats[2]} loss={stats[3]}")
        lines = lines.append("total valid={totals[0]} invalid={totals[1]} score={totals[2]} best={totals[3]} loss={totals[4]}")
        validation_totals[2] += int(#records)
        validation_totals[3] += totals[0]
        validation_totals[4] += totals[1]
        validation_totals[5] += totals[4]
        return lines.append(position_summary(grid)).concat(board.display(grid))

    string[] .ordinary_game(string[] job)
        header := job[0].split(" ")
        name := header[1]
        seed := integer(header[2])
        bag := game.Bag(seed, counts)
        .bag.shuffle()
        grid := board.empty_board()
        player_count := int(#job) - 1
        string[] names := []
        string[] strategies := []
        int[] thresholds := []
        string[] racks := []
        scores := [for p := (0:<int(player_count))[] then 0]
        statistics := [for p := (0:<int(player_count))[] then [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]]
        lines := ["GAME {name} seed={seed} players={player_count}"]
        for: 1 <= i < int(#job)
            fields := job[i].split(" ")
            names = names.append(fields[1])
            strategies = strategies.append(fields[2])
            thresholds = thresholds.append(integer(fields[3]))
            drawn := .bag.draw(7)
            racks = racks.append(drawn)
            lines = lines.append("player {i} {fields[1]} strategy={fields[2]} threshold={integer(fields[3])}")
        turn := 0
        consecutive := 0
        outgoing := -1
        highlight_score := -1
        highlight := ""
        while true
            p := turn % player_count
            turn += 1
            rack := racks[p]
            Evaluated[] legal := legal_moves(grid, rack)
            chosen := if #legal == 0 then -1 else strategy_choice(legal, strategies[p])
            prefix := "turn {turn} {names[p]} rack=" + collection(rack) + " moves={#legal}"
            if chosen >= 0 and not (legal[chosen].score < thresholds[p] and #bag.tiles >= 7)
                candidate := legal[chosen]
                best := legal[0].score
                grid = scoring.apply(grid, candidate.placed)
                scores[p] += candidate.score
                drawn := .bag.draw(7 - int(#candidate.leave))
                racks[p] = candidate.leave + drawn
                statistics[p][0] += 1
                if #candidate.placed == 7
                    statistics[p][1] += 1
                if candidate.score > statistics[p][4]
                    statistics[p][4] = candidate.score
                statistics[p][5] += best - candidate.score
                consecutive = 0
                if candidate.score > highlight_score
                    highlight_score = candidate.score
                    highlight = "highlight turn={turn} player={names[p]} play " + notation(candidate) + " score={candidate.score}"
                lines = lines.append(prefix + " best={best} play " + notation(candidate) + " score={candidate.score} total={scores[p]} draw=" + collection(drawn) + " bag={#bag.tiles}")
                if racks[p] == "" and #bag.tiles == 0
                    outgoing = p
                    break
            elif #bag.tiles >= 7
                string keep := best_leave(rack)
                returned := remove_tiles(rack, keep)
                drawn := .bag.exchange(returned)
                racks[p] = keep + drawn
                statistics[p][2] += 1
                consecutive += 1
                lines = lines.append(prefix + " exchange keep=" + collection(keep) + " draw=" + collection(drawn) + " bag={#bag.tiles}")
            else
                statistics[p][3] += 1
                consecutive += 1
                lines = lines.append(prefix + " pass bag={#bag.tiles}")
            if consecutive == 6
                break
        if outgoing < 0
            lines = lines.append("end reason=scoreless turns={turn}")
        else
            lines = lines.append("end reason=out player={names[outgoing]} turns={turn}")
        adjustments := [for rack := racks[] then -game.points(rack, values)]
        if outgoing >= 0
            adjustment := 0
            for: p < player_count
                if p != outgoing
                    adjustment += game.points(racks[p], values)
            adjustments[outgoing] = adjustment
        final_scores := [for p := (0:<int(player_count))[] then scores[p] + adjustments[p]]
        for: p < player_count
            adjustment := (if adjustments[p] > 0 then "+" else "") + string(adjustments[p])
            lines = lines.append("final {names[p]} score={scores[p]} rack=" + collection(racks[p]) + " adjust={adjustment} total={final_scores[p]}")
        int[] standings := []
        for: 1 <= rank <= player_count
            chosen := -1
            for: p < player_count
                used := false
                for earlier := standings[]
                    used = used or earlier == p
                if not used and (chosen < 0 or final_scores[p] > final_scores[chosen])
                    chosen = p
            standings = standings.append(chosen)
            stats := statistics[chosen]
            lines = lines.append("standing {rank} {names[chosen]} total={final_scores[chosen]} plays={stats[0]} bingos={stats[1]} exchanges={stats[2]} passes={stats[3]} top={stats[4]} loss={stats[5]}")
        winners := [for p := (0:<int(player_count))[] if final_scores[p] == final_scores[standings[0]] then names[p]]
        lines = lines.append("winner " + winners.join(","))
        if highlight != ""
            lines = lines.append(highlight)
        game_totals[3] += turn
        for stats := statistics[]
            game_totals[5] += stats[0]
            game_totals[6] += stats[2]
            game_totals[7] += stats[3]
            game_totals[8] += stats[1]
        return lines.append(position_summary(grid)).concat(board.display(grid))

    string[] .duplicate_game(string[] job)
        header := job[0].split(" ")
        name := header[1]
        seed := integer(header[2])
        player_count := int(#job) - 1
        bag := game.Bag(seed, counts)
        .bag.shuffle()
        grid := board.empty_board()
        rack := .bag.draw(7)
        string[] names := []
        string[] strategies := []
        totals := [for p := (0:<int(player_count))[] then 0]
        lines := ["DUPLICATE {name} seed={seed} players={player_count}"]
        for: 1 <= i < int(#job)
            fields := job[i].split(" ")
            names = names.append(fields[1])
            strategies = strategies.append(fields[2])
            lines = lines.append("player {i} {fields[1]} strategy={fields[2]}")
        round_number := 0
        master_total := 0
        reason := "stuck"
        while true
            Evaluated[] legal := legal_moves(grid, rack)
            if #legal == 0
                break
            round_number += 1
            master := legal[0]
            int[] picks := []
            for: p < player_count
                score := legal[strategy_choice(legal, strategies[p])].score
                totals[p] += score
                picks = picks.append(score)
            master_total += master.score
            lines = lines.append("round {round_number} rack=" + collection(rack) + " moves={#legal} master " + notation(master) + " score={master.score} picks=" + [for score := picks[] then string(score)].join(","))
            grid = scoring.apply(grid, master.placed)
            drawn := .bag.draw(7 - int(#master.leave))
            rack = master.leave + drawn
            if rack == ""
                reason = "out"
                break
        suffix := if reason == "stuck" then " rack=" + collection(rack) else ""
        lines = lines.concat(["end reason={reason} rounds={round_number}" + suffix, "master total={master_total}"])
        maximum := totals[0]
        for: p < player_count
            if totals[p] > maximum
                maximum = totals[p]
            percent := if master_total >= 1 then 100 * totals[p] / master_total else 0
            lines = lines.append("final {names[p]} total={totals[p]} percent={percent}")
        winners := [for p := (0:<int(player_count))[] if totals[p] == maximum then names[p]]
        lines = lines.append("winner " + winners.join(","))
        game_totals[4] += round_number
        return lines.append(position_summary(grid)).concat(board.display(grid))

    void .handle_command()
        string[] seen := []
        for job := input_data.jobs[]
            header := job[0].split(" ")
            kind := header[0]
            name := header[1]
            if kind == "TOPN"
                top_totals[0] += 1
            elif kind == "VALIDATE"
                validation_totals[0] += 1
            elif kind == "GAME"
                game_totals[0] += 1
            else
                game_totals[1] += 1
            string reason := job_error(job, seen)
            seen = seen.append(name)
            string[] paragraph := []
            if reason != ""
                paragraph = [kind + " " + name, "error " + reason]
                if kind == "TOPN"
                    top_totals[1] += 1
                elif kind == "VALIDATE"
                    validation_totals[1] += 1
                else
                    game_totals[2] += 1
            elif kind == "TOPN"
                paragraph = .topn(job)
            elif kind == "VALIDATE"
                paragraph = .validate(job)
            elif kind == "GAME"
                paragraph = .ordinary_game(job)
            else
                paragraph = .duplicate_game(job)
            if kind == "TOPN"
                move_blocks = move_blocks.append(paragraph)
            elif kind == "VALIDATE"
                validation_blocks = validation_blocks.append(paragraph)
            else
                game_blocks = game_blocks.append(paragraph)
        move_blocks = move_blocks.append(["SUMMARY jobs={top_totals[0]} errors={top_totals[1]} moves={top_totals[2]} bingos={top_totals[3]}"])
        validation_blocks = validation_blocks.append(["SUMMARY jobs={validation_totals[0]} errors={validation_totals[1]} moves={validation_totals[2]} valid={validation_totals[3]} invalid={validation_totals[4]} loss={validation_totals[5]}"])
        game_blocks = game_blocks.append(["SUMMARY games={game_totals[0]} duplicates={game_totals[1]} errors={game_totals[2]} turns={game_totals[3]} rounds={game_totals[4]} plays={game_totals[5]} exchanges={game_totals[6]} passes={game_totals[7]} bingos={game_totals[8]}"])

void write_blocks(string name, string[][] blocks)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1([for block := blocks[] then block.join(NL)].join(NL + NL) + NL)

void run_program()
    program := Scrabble(Inputs())
    .program.handle_command()
    write_blocks("moves.txt", program.move_blocks)
    write_blocks("validation.txt", program.validation_blocks)
    write_blocks("game.txt", program.game_blocks)

run_program()

import board = "./board.qui"
import dictionary_trie = "./dictionary_trie.qui"
import scoring = "./scoring.qui"

bool[][] anchors(string[][] grid)
    result := [for row := (0:<15)[] then [for column := (0:<15)[] then false]]
    if #board.tiles(grid) == 0
        result[7][7] = true
        return result
    for: row < 15
        for: column < 15
            if grid[row][column] == "."
                for point := board.neighbours(row, column)[]
                    if grid[point[0]][point[1]] != "."
                        result[row][column] = true
    return result

class Checks(bool[][] needed, bool[][][] allowed)

Checks cross_checks(string[][] grid, dictionary_trie.Trie trie)
    needed := [for row := (0:<15)[] then [for column := (0:<15)[] then false]]
    allowed := [for row := (0:<15)[] then [for column := (0:<15)[] then [for letter := (0:<26)[] then true]]]
    for: row < 15
        for: column < 15
            if grid[row][column] != "."
                continue
            first := row
            last := row
            while first > 0 and grid[first - 1][column] != "."
                first -= 1
            while last + 1 < 15 and grid[last + 1][column] != "."
                last += 1
            if first == last
                continue
            needed[row][column] = true
            prefix := [for r := (int(first):<int(row))[] then grid[r][column]].join("")
            suffix := [for r := (int(row + 1):<(int(last) + 1))[] then grid[r][column]].join("")
            for: letter < 26
                allowed[row][column][letter] = trie.has(board.uppercase(prefix) + board.letters[letter] + board.uppercase(suffix))
    return Checks(needed, allowed)

class Search(string[][] grid, string rack, dictionary_trie.Trie trie, bool[][] anchor_squares, Checks checks)
    int[] counts := [for i := (0:<27)[] then 0]
    for: i < int(#rack)
        tile := if rack[i] == "?" then 26 else board.character_index(board.letters, rack[i])
        counts[tile] += 1
    board.Move[] result := []

    void .extend_right(int row, int anchor, int node, int column, string word, int start, int[] remaining)
        empty := column == 15 or grid[row][column] == "."
        if empty and column > anchor and trie.terminal[node]
            result = result.append(board.Move(row, start, 0, word))
        if column == 15
            return
        if not empty
            character := grid[row][column]
            letter := board.character_index(board.letters, board.uppercase(character))
            child := trie.children[node][letter]
            if child >= 0
                .extend_right(row, anchor, child, column + 1, word + character, start, remaining)
            return
        for: letter < 26
            child := trie.children[node][letter]
            if child < 0 or not checks.allowed[row][column][letter]
                continue
            for: alternative < 2
                tile := if alternative == 0 then letter else 26
                if remaining[tile] > 0
                    next := remaining
                    next[tile] -= 1
                    string character := if alternative == 0 then board.letters[letter] else board.lowercase_letters[letter]
                    .extend_right(row, anchor, child, column + 1, word + character, start, next)

    void .left_part(int row, int anchor, int node, string prefix, int limit, int[] remaining)
        .extend_right(row, anchor, node, anchor, prefix, anchor - int(#prefix), remaining)
        if limit == 0
            return
        for: letter < 26
            child := trie.children[node][letter]
            if child < 0
                continue
            for: alternative < 2
                tile := if alternative == 0 then letter else 26
                if remaining[tile] > 0
                    next := remaining
                    next[tile] -= 1
                    string character := if alternative == 0 then board.letters[letter] else board.lowercase_letters[letter]
                    .left_part(row, anchor, child, prefix + character, limit - 1, next)

    void .across_moves()
        for: row < 15
            for: anchor < 15
                if not anchor_squares[row][anchor]
                    continue
                if anchor > 0 and grid[row][anchor - 1] != "."
                    first := anchor - 1
                    while first > 0 and grid[row][first - 1] != "."
                        first -= 1
                    prefix := grid[row][first:<anchor].join("")
                    node := trie.prefix(board.uppercase(prefix))
                    if node >= 0
                        .extend_right(row, anchor, node, anchor, prefix, first, counts)
                else
                    first := anchor - 1
                    while first >= 0 and grid[row][first] == "." and not anchor_squares[row][first]
                        first -= 1
                    .left_part(row, anchor, 0, "", anchor - first - 1, counts)

board.Move[] generate(string[][] grid, string rack, dictionary_trie.Trie trie)
    anchor_squares := anchors(grid)
    across := Search(grid, rack, trie, anchor_squares, cross_checks(grid, trie))
    .across.across_moves()
    transposed := board.transpose(grid)
    swapped := [for row := (0:<15)[] then [for column := (0:<15)[] then anchor_squares[column][row]]]
    down := Search(transposed, rack, trie, swapped, cross_checks(transposed, trie))
    .down.across_moves()
    result := across.result
    for candidate := down.result[]
        move := board.Move(candidate.column, candidate.row, 1, candidate.word)
        placed := scoring.placement(grid, move)
        if #placed == 1
            after := scoring.apply(grid, placed)
            if #board.run_at(after, placed[0].row, placed[0].column, 0).word >= 2
                continue
        result = result.append(move)
    return result

import board = "./board.qui"

const rack_size := 7
const bingo_bonus := 50

board.Tile[] squares(board.Move move)
    return [for i := (0:<int(#move.word))[] then board.Tile(move.row + move.direction * i, move.column + (1 - move.direction) * i, move.word[i])]

board.Tile[] placement(string[][] grid, board.Move move)
    return [for tile := squares(move)[] if grid[tile.row][tile.column] == "." then tile]

string[][] apply(string[][] grid, board.Tile[] placed)
    result := grid
    for tile := placed[]
        result[tile.row][tile.column] = tile.letter
    return result

board.Move[] cross_words(string[][] grid, board.Move move)
    placed := placement(grid, move)
    after := apply(grid, placed)
    board.Move[] result := []
    for tile := placed[]
        word := board.run_at(after, tile.row, tile.column, 1 - move.direction)
        if #word.word >= 2
            result = result.append(word)
    return result

int word_score(string[][] grid, board.Move word, int[] values)
    score := 0
    multiplier := 1
    layout := board.premiums()
    for tile := squares(word)[]
        letter := board.character_index(board.letters, tile.letter)
        value := if letter < 0 then 0 else values[letter]
        if grid[tile.row][tile.column] == "."
            premium := layout[tile.row][tile.column]
            value *= if premium == "+" then 2 else (if premium == "^" then 3 else 1)
            multiplier *= if premium == "*" then 2 else (if premium == "#" then 3 else 1)
        score += value
    return score * multiplier

class Scored(int score, board.Tile[] placed, board.Move[] words, int[] word_scores)

Scored score_move(string[][] grid, board.Move move, int[] values)
    board.Move[] words := [move].concat(cross_words(grid, move))
    word_scores := [for word := words[] then word_score(grid, word, values)]
    score := 0
    for value := word_scores[]
        score += value
    placed := placement(grid, move)
    if #placed == rack_size
        score += bingo_bonus
    return Scored(score, placed, words, word_scores)
